items.prompt: A valid zero-quantity row is removed by a declared qty>0 output filter. How should it be counted?

options.text: As deliberately filtered, not an invalid input
options.why: This schema permits zero; the transform selects a narrower output.

options.text: As a rejected numeric schema violation
options.why: That contradicts this lesson's nonnegative input policy.

options.text: As an accepted trade silently duplicated elsewhere
options.why: No duplication is part of the stated filter.

options.text: It should disappear from every count and report

items.explanation: Validation and selection answer different questions. Preserve enough counts and policy metadata to distinguish them.
